_comment: Drop-in fragment for ~/.pi/agent/models.json. Verified working against the live
endpoint on 2026-10-14 — see PLAN.md §2.3. Merge the `providers` entry below into
an existing providers object, or paste it as-is if there is none.
A SIBLING provider id on purpose: it does not shadow the built-in `minimax-cn`, so
`unregisterProvider`-equivalent rollback is deleting one block, and `minimax-cn/M3`
The three fields that matter, and why:
thinkingLevelMap off/minimal:null -> those levels are UNSUPPORTED (disabled 400s)
xhigh/max mapped explicitly  -> opt-in only; pi never offers them unmapped
